This is a successor role on a defined architect track: the person hired will be trained to become the architect for the ELERA POS client. This is a platform role, not a feature role. jobs.title: Software Engineer IV, Payment Platform
jobs.description_text: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineer IV to lead the transaction-processing core of our payment systems platform. Responsibilities include ownership of the terminal transport layer, store-and-forward (SAF) handling, decline and exception fallback logic, and BIN-based routing to ensure reliable card-present payments across our retail network. This is a hands-on role, not focused on requirements documentation or committee work. You will work directly with transport and transaction-state code, reproduce terminal-level failures, and manage fixes through to production. Success requires strong expertise in banking and card payments, including issuers, card networks, acquiring processors, authorization and settlement flows, and distributed-systems engineering. This position offers a clear path to payment architecture ownership. You will apply your distributed-systems and Java expertise, learn our payment transaction lifecycle and terminal protocols through hands-on defect resolution and root-cause analysis in your first year, and advance to architectural ownership of the payment transport and transaction-integrity layer. Our technology stack includes Java and JavaScript applications built with Maven and delivered through a Jenkins CI/CD pipeline. We use a Vue 3/TypeScript POS checkout client that interacts with our transaction and device APIs. Docker and Kubernetes support our build, test, and deployment processes. jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is building the Virtual Cell World Model - a persistent, multimodal AI system that predicts, simulates, and ultimately programs cellular behavior. Rather than producing isolated predictions, the Virtual Cell enables scientists to query cellular states, perform virtual perturbations, and design new biological interventions within a unified computational world. Together with AIDO Foundry, our AI-native engineering framework for automating Virtual Cell development, we are building the software infrastructure for the next generation of AI-driven drug discovery. As our team scales, we are seeking a highly execution-oriented Director of Engineering to drive a culture of engineering excellence and rapid delivery at our Palo Alto office. The core objective of this role is to translate our long-term vision into actionable engineering roadmaps, enforce rigorous timelines, and successfully operationalize our research into production-grade systems.

The Mission Systems Engineer (MSE) is the single point of technical accountability for systems engineering on an assigned government contract or task order. The MSE owns that mission's requirements baseline, interface control, verification and validation planning, and requirements compliance closure — reporting to the Program Manager and/or the Chief Systems Engineer (CSE), as assigned. The MSE operates within the enterprise system architecture and electrical ICD framework owned by the CSE, and is the CSE's forward-deployed counterpart on the contract: translating fleet-level architecture and standards into mission-specific requirements, schedules, and customer commitments.
